Use numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None); report rank, conditioning, training MSE, held validation/development MAE and source-grouped feature counts. Persist fitted matrix, normalization, raw predictions and independent normal-equation/second-solver residual checks. Do not feed typed exact facts into this regression.

decision_tree.privileged_truth_fails: Correct truth/construction before further learned interpretation; preserve old evidence and never force audit acceptance.
decision_tree.conditional_control_passes_parent_develo: Test a prospectively frozen unchanged recipe on fresh independently audited fields/phrases/worlds and an untouched final before any promotion; old development success earns no capability credit.
decision_tree.conditional_and_cross_inadequate: Retire only these demonstrated inadequate frozen final-mean/readout interfaces, not semantic information in all encoder states. Use component oracle/linear ceilings to preregister one targeted representation change on fresh material: minimal final-layer task adaptation if semantic match/polarity is limiting, or explicit caller-supplied ordinal rubric grounding if grade identifiability is limiting. Do not repeat global numeric reconstruction, arbitrarily widen heads, or select on closed ECA final.
decision_tree.knownness_only_limiting: Preregister presence/contradiction supervision with fresh final; never lower closed final trust thresholds or weaken missing-candidate UNKNOWN policy.
